attributes.name: Email Address
attributes.description: =Find the most relevant business email (e.g., info@, hello@, or the founder's name). Ensure it follows the proper name@domain.com format. If multiple exist, prioritize the one most likely to be used for business inquiries.

attributes.name: Short Description
attributes.description: A concise 1-sentence summary (max 20 words) of what the business actually does. Focus on their primary service or product.

attributes.name: Fun Fact/Personalization Hook
attributes.description: Identify one specific, unique detail about this company that could be used as an icebreaker in a cold email. This could be a specific project they mentioned, a unique value proposition, an award, or their specific location in Kathmandu (if applicable). Avoid generic statements like "They have a great team."

PARTNER WITH NEW YORK LOGISTICS EXPERTS TO GROW YOUR REACH, BOTTOM LINE


DELIGHT CUSTOMERS WITH ENHANCED TRANSPORTATION LOGISTICS SOLUTIONS FROM ONE OF
THE LEADING FREIGHT COMPANIES IN NEW YORK

Whether your organization is based on the U.S. East Coast, or half a world
away,  AIT’s Long Island team is ready to help you scale. Backed by decades of
experience and global infrastructure, our New York logistics professionals
deliver custom transportation logistics solutions [/solutions/] to meet your
regional and international shipping needs.

As one of the most trusted New York logistics companies, we specialize
in home delivery, retail fulfillment, and global freight forwarding from Long
Island to anywhere in the world. Our full suite of services include:

 * Comprehensive air [/services/air-freight/], ground
   [/services/ground-distribution/], sea [/services/sea-freight/], and
   intermodal  [/services/intermodal/]door-to-door services
 * Concierge, white glove delivery [/services/white-glove/] options
 * Warehouse management [/services/warehouse-management/] expertise
 * Simple software integration [/services/transportation-technology/]
 * In-house customs brokerage
   [/services/customs-clearance/ait-customs-brokerage/] and Wheels Up customs
   clearance program [/services/wheel-s-up-clearance/]
 * And much more [/services/]!

Next Slide



WHAT SETS AIT APART FROM OTHER LOGISTICS COMPANIES IN NEW YORK?

At AIT, our business is supply chain solutions. We're a freight forwarder,
yes—but we're much more than that.

For customers looking for New York logistics companies, and all our clients all
around the world, we act as a transportation services liaison—a deeply
experienced and connected [/about-ait/] access point to a worldwide network of
professionals and resources.

Our reach and expertise spans across every cargo channel and method, from air to
sea to road to rail. And our collection of logistics support services includes a
mix of offerings shippers won't find anywhere else, including insurance,
advanced technology integrations, in-house customs brokerage, and more.


WHAT TYPES OF SHIPMENTS DOES AIT-LONG ISLAND HANDLE?

Our talented team of freight forwarders on Long Island is part of a global
network that creates transportation logistics solutions every day for nearly
every industry [/solutions/], with a strong local focus on home delivery
[/solutions/residential/].


WHAT RETAIL OR RESIDENTIAL DELIVERY SERVICES CAN AIT-LONG ISLAND PROVIDE?

Since 2001, our team on Long Island has served some of the largest retailers and
e-commerce companies in the world as part of Select Express & Logistics
[/services/ground-distribution/final-mile-delivery/]. So, whether you're
shipping to a single-family home, a warehouse, or a store, they'll work with you
to develop a creative, flexible logistics solution that will give you an edge in
today's highly competitive landscape. Their comprehensive list of retail and
residential delivery services include:
 * Threshold
 * Room of choice
 * White glove
 * In-home/In-store assembly
 * Dedicated vehicles
 * On-demand local couriers


DOES AIT HAVE FREIGHT FORWARDING FACILITIES OUTSIDE OF LONG ISLAND?

Yes! Our expanding footprint currently includes more than 150 facilities across
Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America.

In New York state, you’ll find AIT’s specialized Life Sciences team
[https://www.aitworldwide.com/locations/new-york-new-york-life-sciences/], our
Syracuse freight forwarding team
[https://www.aitworldwide.com/locations/syracuse-new-york/], and our home
delivery logistics team
[https://www.aitworldwide.com/locations/new-york-new-york-3/] serving the
broader metro region.
Explore AIT's global locations [https://www.aitworldwide.com/locations/]


WHAT CARGO SECURITY MEASURES AND CERTIFICATIONS DOES AIT'S LONG ISLAND SHIPPING
FACILITY PROVIDE?

AIT is a member of the Transport Asset Protection Association
[/risk-management/tapa/], and all of AIT's North American locations feature
multiple, advanced safety and security features, including 24-hour monitoring,
closed-circuit cameras, keypad access and a driver check-in and escort policy.

All U.S. AIT facilities are also authorized economic operators
[/risk-management/authorized-economic-operator/].
Learn more about AIT's credentials and approach to cargo security
[https://www.aitworldwide.com/risk-management/cargo-security/]


TEAM WITH ONE OF THE TOP NEW YORK LOGISTICS COMPANIES

Whether you need help with local New York logistics or global transportation
solutions, when you add one of the leading freight companies in New York to your
bench, you'll see instant results. 

CONTACT AN AIT REPRESENTATIVE [/contact-us/ship-with-ait/]
